indices.title: Overnight index moves and breadth
indices.body: Nasdaq: +0.35% · S&P 500: +0.30% · VIX: −0.32%. Need more breadth in this market for a sustained rally, IMO. The rate hike story is a big factor too. Checking Polymarket, there was a slight bump in the odds the Fed DOESN'T touch rates in the wake of that PCE print, sitting around 66% chance of a no-touch. Today is the last day of September, and also the last day of the quarter.

bonds.title: Treasury yields
bonds.body: The table pairs the U.S. Treasury's Sep 29 par-curve closes with the latest sourced Sep 30 premarket quotes found. Reuters reported a 2Y quote from European hours; Barron's, citing Tradeweb, reported 10Y and 30Y quotes during Asian trading. Those are not synchronized cutoff observations. No verified premarket 5Y quote was found, so it remains blank.
